<?php
/**
 * Rate-limited HTTP client with retry logic for microservice communication.
 * Uses a connection pool with reference-counted resource management.
 */

class ConnectionHandle {
    private $resource;
    private $pool;
    private $released = false;
    private $id;

    public function __construct($resource, ConnectionPool $pool, string $id) {
        $this->resource = $resource;
        $this->pool = $pool;
        $this->id = $id;
    }

    public function getId(): string {
        return $this->id;
    }

    public function getResource() {
        return $this->resource;
    }

    public function release(): void {
        if (!$this->released) {
            $this->released = true;
            $this->pool->returnConnection($this);
        }
    }

    public function isReleased(): bool {
        return $this->released;
    }

    public function __destruct() {
        $this->release();
    }
}

class ConnectionPool {
    private $available = [];
    private $inUse = [];
    private $maxSize;
    private $destroyedIds = [];

    public function __construct(int $maxSize = 10) {
        $this->maxSize = $maxSize;
    }

    public function acquire(): ConnectionHandle {
        if (!empty($this->available)) {
            $id = array_key_first($this->available);
            $resource = $this->available[$id];
            unset($this->available[$id]);
            $this->inUse[$id] = $resource;
            return new ConnectionHandle($resource, $this, $id);
        }

        if (count($this->inUse) < $this->maxSize) {
            $id = uniqid('conn_', true);
            $resource = $this->createResource($id);
            $this->inUse[$id] = $resource;
            return new ConnectionHandle($resource, $this, $id);
        }

        throw new \RuntimeException('Connection pool exhausted');
    }

    public function returnConnection(ConnectionHandle $handle): void {
        $id = $handle->getId();
        if (isset($this->inUse[$id])) {
            $resource = $this->inUse[$id];
            unset($this->inUse[$id]);
            $this->available[$id] = $resource;
        }
    }

    public function destroyConnection(ConnectionHandle $handle): void {
        $id = $handle->getId();
        if (in_array($id, $this->destroyedIds)) {
            return; // Already destroyed, prevent double-free
        }
        if (isset($this->inUse[$id])) {
            $this->freeResource($this->inUse[$id]);
            unset($this->inUse[$id]);
            $this->destroyedIds[] = $id;
        } elseif (isset($this->available[$id])) {
            $this->freeResource($this->available[$id]);
            unset($this->available[$id]);
            $this->destroyedIds[] = $id;
        }
    }

    private function createResource(string $id) {
        return curl_init();
    }

    private function freeResource($resource): void {
        if (is_resource($resource) || $resource instanceof \CurlHandle) {
            curl_close($resource);
        }
    }

    public function getStats(): array {
        return [
            'available' => count($this->available),
            'in_use' => count($this->inUse),
            'destroyed' => count($this->destroyedIds),
        ];
    }
}

class RateLimiter {
    private $tokens;
    private $maxTokens;
    private $refillRate;
    private $lastRefill;

    public function __construct(int $maxTokens = 100, float $refillRate = 10.0) {
        $this->tokens = $maxTokens;
        $this->maxTokens = $maxTokens;
        $this->refillRate = $refillRate;
        $this->lastRefill = microtime(true);
    }

    public function tryAcquire(): bool {
        $this->refill();
        if ($this->tokens > 0) {
            $this->tokens--;
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    private function refill(): void {
        $now = microtime(true);
        $elapsed = $now - $this->lastRefill;
        $newTokens = $elapsed * $this->refillRate;
        $this->tokens = min($this->maxTokens, $this->tokens + $newTokens);
        $this->lastRefill = $now;
    }
}

class RetryableHttpClient {
    private $pool;
    private $rateLimiter;
    private $maxRetries;
    private $retryableStatuses = [429, 500, 502, 503, 504];

    public function __construct(ConnectionPool $pool, RateLimiter $rateLimiter, int $maxRetries = 3) {
        $this->pool = $pool;
        $this->rateLimiter = $rateLimiter;
        $this->maxRetries = $maxRetries;
    }

    public function request(string $method, string $url, array $options = []): array {
        $lastException = null;
        $handle = null;

        for ($attempt = 0; $attempt <= $this->maxRetries; $attempt++) {
            if (!$this->rateLimiter->tryAcquire()) {
                usleep(100000);
                continue;
            }

            try {
                $handle = $this->pool->acquire();
                $result = $this->executeRequest($handle, $method, $url, $options);

                if (in_array($result['status'], $this->retryableStatuses)) {
                    // On retryable error, destroy the potentially bad connection
                    $this->pool->destroyConnection($handle);
                    $handle = null; // Prevent destructor double-free
                    $lastException = new \RuntimeException("HTTP {$result['status']}");
                    $this->backoff($attempt);
                    continue;
                }

                // Success path - release connection back to pool
                $handle->release();
                return $result;

            } catch (\RuntimeException $e) {
                $lastException = $e;
                if ($handle !== null) {
                    $this->pool->destroyConnection($handle);
                    $handle = null; // Prevent destructor double-free
                }
                $this->backoff($attempt);
            }
        }

        throw new \RuntimeException(
            "Request failed after {$this->maxRetries} retries: " . ($lastException ? $lastException->getMessage() : 'unknown'),
            0,
            $lastException
        );
    }

    private function executeRequest(ConnectionHandle $handle, string $method, string $url, array $options): array {
        $ch = $handle->getResource();
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_URL, $url);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, true);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_CUSTOMREQUEST, $method);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_TIMEOUT, $options['timeout'] ?? 30);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_CONNECTTIMEOUT, $options['connect_timeout'] ?? 5);

        // Explicitly enforce TLS certificate verification (CWE-295).
        // Pooled/reused handles must not be allowed to run with weakened
        // verification settings from a previous request.
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER, true);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYHOST, 2);

        if (isset($options['headers'])) {
            curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER, $options['headers']);
        }

        if (isset($options['body'])) {
            curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS, $options['body']);
        }

        $response = curl_exec($ch);
        $httpCode = curl_getinfo($ch, CURLINFO_HTTP_CODE);

        if ($response === false) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Curl error: ' . curl_error($ch));
        }

        return [
            'status' => $httpCode,
            'body' => $response,
        ];
    }

    private function backoff(int $attempt): void {
        $delay = min(1000000, (2 ** $attempt) * 100000);
        usleep($delay);
    }
}

// Service entry point
function handleServiceRequest(array $config): array {
    $pool = new ConnectionPool($config['pool_size'] ?? 10);
    $limiter = new RateLimiter($config['rate_limit'] ?? 100, $config['refill_rate'] ?? 10.0);
    $client = new RetryableHttpClient($pool, $limiter, $config['max_retries'] ?? 3);

    try {
        $result = $client->request(
            $config['method'] ?? 'GET',
            $config['url'],
            $config['options'] ?? []
        );
        return ['success' => true, 'data' => $result, 'pool_stats' => $pool->getStats()];
    } catch (\RuntimeException $e) {
        return ['success' => false, 'error' => $e->getMessage(), 'pool_stats' => $pool->getStats()];
    }
}
